impact_summary: Railway subway fully submerged; vehicular traffic suspended for 16 hours; TNSTC buses diverted.
source: Tamil Nadu State Disaster Management Authority (TNSDMA) / Coimbatore Corporation

impact_summary: Lake water breached bund on bypass road; ground floor shops inundated; 120 residents relocated.
Arterial highway partially blocked; 2 km gridlock; water entering low-lying residential layouts.
Cross Cut road waterlogged up to knee height; basement parking in commercial complexes flooded.
source: The Hindu / Times of India Local Bureau

impact_summary: Auto-rickshaw trapped in underpass; rescued by Fire & Rescue Services; water pumped overnight.
source: Tamil Nadu Fire and Rescue Services (TNFRS)

impact_summary: Valankulam surplus canal overflowed onto service lanes; low-lying tenements waterlogged.
Heritage storm drain choked with plastic silt; street vendors moved; knee-level ponding.
Noyyal river level touched warning mark at Perur causeway; causeway barricaded.
Underpass inundated; heavy pump deployment; traffic rerouted through Goods Shed Road.
Intense 1-hour downpour overwhelmed storm drains; railway underpass closed for 4 hours.
Railway colony entrance road water accumulation; cleared naturally in 3 hours.
